第一步：找到神庙底座
Step 1: Find the Shrine Pedestal
神庙的位置在萨托利山麓（海拉鲁平原的西边一点）。当你哼着小曲儿溜达过去的时候，会发现那里只有一个光秃秃的神庙底座。
The shrine is located at the Satori Mountain Foothills (a little to the west of Hyrule Plain). When you hum a little tune and wander over, you'll find only a bare shrine pedestal there.

林克站在一个圆环底座前，按 A 键互动后，一道绿油油的激光冲天而起，直指远方的一座山崖——这就是在告诉你：“兄弟，去顺着光把我的水晶搬回来。”

Link stands before a ring-shaped pedestal; after pressing A to interact, a bright green beam of light shoots into the sky, pointing at a distant cliff — it's telling you: “Buddy, follow the light and bring my crystal back.”
别犹豫，顺着这道绿光走。你会发现绿光指引你来到了一个洞窟——萨托利山麓的洞窟。
Don't hesitate — follow this green light. You'll find the green light leads you to a cave — the Satori Mountain Foothills Cave.

⚔️ Step 2: Enter the Cave for Treasure and Meet an “Old Friend”
刚进洞窟的时候，环境有点暗，走两步你就会听到一阵震耳欲聋的呼噜声。顺着绿光往里走，你会看到一个无比熟悉的身影——一只巨大的西诺克斯（独眼巨怪）正在呼呼大睡。

When you first enter the cave, it's a bit dark, and after a few steps you'll hear deafening snoring. Follow the green light deeper in and you'll see an extremely familiar figure — a huge Hinox (the one-eyed giant monster) fast asleep.

第三步：搬运水晶，激活神庙
Step 3: Carry the Crystal and Activate the Shrine
拿到水晶之后，就没啥技术含量了，纯纯的体力活。
Once you've got the crystal, there's no skill involved anymore — it's pure manual labor.
林克双手举着一块比自己上半身还大的绿色水晶，步履蹒跚地走出洞穴。要是嫌走得慢，直接用“究极手”把水晶抓在半空中往前跑。

Link holds a green crystal bigger than his own upper body above his head with both hands and staggers out of the cave. If you think walking is too slow, just use Ultrahand to grab the crystal in midair and run forward with it.
把水晶一路搬回神庙底座，靠近底座的时候，水晶会自动触发动画，飞到天上，随后“哐当”一声——完整的乌萨诸马神庙拔地而起！

Carry the crystal all the way back to the shrine pedestal; as you get close to the pedestal, the crystal automatically triggers a cutscene, flies up into the sky, and then with a “clang” — the complete Usazum Shrine rises from the ground!

第四步：进庙领奖
Step 4: Enter the Shrine and Claim Your Reward
现在，大摇大摆地走进神庙吧。里面没有任何烦人的方块、弹簧或者轨道，地上铺着红地毯，直接走向正中央的宝箱。
Now, stride boldly into the shrine. There are no annoying blocks, springs, or rails inside — a red carpet is laid on the floor, so just walk straight to the treasure chest in the center.

🎁 神庙奖励
🎁 Shrine Rewards
宝箱奖励：结实的左纳乌武器 或 大能源（白嫖的总是最香的）
Chest reward: a sturdy Zonai weapon or a Large Zonaite (free loot is always the sweetest)
最终奖励：走上台阶，跟劳鲁的幻影打个招呼，拿下你的祝福之光
Final reward: walk up the steps, say hello to Rauru's apparition, and claim your Light of Blessing
🏆 老司机终极心得
🏆 Veteran Player's Ultimate Tips
方案A的奖励远比方案B丰厚——打掉西诺克斯不仅能拿到水晶，还能白赚一堆稀有材料。如果装备允许，永远优先选剑圣流，不要浪费这个白嫖机会！

Option A's rewards are far richer than Option B's — defeating the Hinox not only gets you the crystal, it also earns you a pile of rare materials for free. If your gear allows it, always pick the Swordmaster style first — don't waste this free-loot opportunity!
